description: Stylized graphic of a U.S. flag with a solid blue canton (no stars) and simplified red stripes, above the slogan 'BE THE DIFFERENCE. VOTE' with a trademark symbol. A get-out-the-vote graphic; filename in the archive is 'voter-pledge.jpg'.

Photoshopped photograph of a cinema 'Now Playing' marquee showing three parody movie posters. Screen 4 shows 'Guardians of the Pedophiles', a doctored Guardians of the Galaxy poster. Screen 5 shows 'Panic in DC' with the tagline 'They never thought she would lose' attributed to Q. Screen 6 shows 'FISAGATE', a fake thriller poster picturing Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, James Comey and Andrew McCabe (plus a fifth woman) with five-star 'review' quotes attributed to Republican congressmen about the FISA/Nunes memo.
text: NOW PLAYING. 4. 5. 6. GUARDIANS OF THE PEDOPHILES. FROM THE STUDIO THAT BROUGHT YOU THE AVENGERS. "THEY NEVER THOUGHT SHE WOULD LOSE" -Q. PANIC IN DC. IN THEATERS NOW. FISAGATE. "What I saw is absolutely shocking" Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the [unclear] of places" Matt Gaetz. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen." Steve King. "As soon as you read the Memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB?" Scott Perry.
flags: Satirical/doctored image — the posters are fabricated, not real films
Poster accuses Marvel film cast/studio of pedophilia by parody title — an unsubstantiated smear
Fifth face on the FISAGATE poster not confidently identified
Some fine-print poster text too small to read exactly; one Gaetz quote word unclear

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated 7 Nov 2018 (the day after the midterm elections), warning that if House Democrats investigate his administration he will consider having the Senate investigate them for leaks of classified information.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Following. If the Democrats think they are going to waste Taxpayer Money investigating us at the House level, then we will likewise be forced to consider investigating them for all of the leaks of Classified Information, and much else, at the Senate level. Two can play that game!. 8:04 AM - 7 Nov 2018
